headline.note: reps 1..10 (paper-weighted sample); models[].conditions, coverage, fault_families and paired use only these rows

extension.note: rep-file reps (bench/winnable_reps.json); excluded from the headline rates, included in winnable (all) and shim lift (all)

winnable.rule: first_entry != OP4/permanent (null first_entry counts as zero dose and is kept)

between_model_mcnemar.test: exact two-sided McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs)

bonferroni_families.3: the 3 model pairs within one condition and scope
bonferroni_families.9: 3 model pairs × 3 conditions (clean, chaos, chaos_scoped) within one scope

shim_analysis.test: exact two-sided McNemar (binomial on discordant pairs); Bonferroni ×3 across models
shim_analysis.note: Primary analysis: chaos_scoped_shim vs chaos_scoped. Slices and the chaos/clean comparisons are secondary (not confirmatory). Shim fields are null while the shim arm is pending.

after_error.population: chaos_scoped pairs whose no-shim run had faults > 0
after_error.retry_rule: same tool, same arguments, issued after an error result for that call came back

kinds.stopped: neither retried nor called a fallback after the target's first error
kinds.fallback: called a fallback tool named in profiles/shim.yaml after the first error
kinds.retried: repeated a failed (target, arguments) call after its error came back

extension_winnable.label: seed-selected, not paper-faithful
extension_winnable.rule: first_entry != OP4/permanent (null first_entry counts as zero dose and is kept)
